"""A tiny game to build on. Change the numbers and see what happens."""

import pygame

# Things you can change
WIDTH = 640
HEIGHT = 480
PLAYER_SPEED = 5
PLAYER_SIZE = 40
BACKGROUND = (18, 22, 34)
PLAYER_COLOUR = (214, 142, 62)

pygame.init()
screen = pygame.display.set_mode((WIDTH, HEIGHT))
pygame.display.set_caption("My Game")
clock = pygame.time.Clock()

player = pygame.Rect(WIDTH // 2, HEIGHT // 2, PLAYER_SIZE, PLAYER_SIZE)

running = True
while running:
    for event in pygame.event.get():
        if event.type == pygame.QUIT:
            running = False
        elif event.type == pygame.KEYDOWN and event.key == pygame.K_ESCAPE:
            running = False

    keys = pygame.key.get_pressed()
    if keys[pygame.K_LEFT]:
        player.x -= PLAYER_SPEED
    if keys[pygame.K_RIGHT]:
        player.x += PLAYER_SPEED
    if keys[pygame.K_UP]:
        player.y -= PLAYER_SPEED
    if keys[pygame.K_DOWN]:
        player.y += PLAYER_SPEED

    player.clamp_ip(screen.get_rect())

    screen.fill(BACKGROUND)
    pygame.draw.rect(screen, PLAYER_COLOUR, player)
    pygame.display.flip()
    clock.tick(60)

pygame.quit()

HEIGHT = 480

# Game settings

# Initialize Pygame

pygame.display.set_caption("Night Woods Shooter")

# Clock for FPS

clock = pygame.time.Clock()

player_speed = 5

# Game loop

while running:
    # Handle events
    for event in pygame.event.get():
        if event.type == pygame.QUIT:
            running = False
        elif event.type == pygame.KEYDOWN:
            if event.key == pygame.K_ESCAPE:
                running = False

    # Move player
    keys = pygame.key.get_pressed()
    if keys[pygame.K_LEFT]:
        player.x -= player_speed
    if keys[pygame.K_RIGHT]:
        player.x += player_speed
    if keys[pygame.K_UP]:
        player.y -= player_speed
    if keys[pygame.K_DOWN]:
        player.y += player_speed

    # Clear screen
    screen.fill(BACKGROUND)

    # Draw player
    pygame.draw.rect(screen, PLAYER_COLOUR, player)

    # Update display
    pygame.display.flip()

    # Cap the frame rate
    clock.tick(FPS)

# Quit Pygame
pygame.quit()

# End of game.py

"""A tiny game to build on. Change the numbers and see what happens."""

import pygame

from scene import Circle, Drawing, Ellipse, Picture, Scene, Sky

# Things you can change
WIDTH = 640
HEIGHT = 480
PLAYER_SPEED = 5
PLAYER_SIZE = 40
BACKGROUND = (40, 70, 150)  # black for night
PLAYER_COLOUR = (214, 142, 62)  # orange player
SCORE_COLOUR = (240, 240, 240)

pygame.init()
screen = pygame.display.set_mode((WIDTH, HEIGHT))
pygame.display.set_caption("Night Woods Shooter")
clock = pygame.time.Clock()

player = pygame.Rect(WIDTH // 2, HEIGHT // 2, PLAYER_SIZE, PLAYER_SIZE)

# The scene: everything the game shows, drawn back to front by scene.draw().
scene = Scene(screen)
sky = scene.add("sky", Sky(BACKGROUND), size=(640, 480), at=(0, 0), layer="background")
trees = scene.add("trees", [
    Picture("assets/tree_01.png"),
    Picture("assets/tree_02.png"),
    Picture("assets/tree_03.png"),
    Picture("assets/tree_04.png"),
    Picture("assets/tree_05.png"),
    Picture("assets/tree_06.png"),
], size=(90, 120), at=(0, 300), count=5, vary=0.25, layer="things")
monsters = scene.add("monsters", Drawing((40, 40), [
    Circle(20, 20, 18, "purple"),
    Ellipse(0, 16, 40, 8, "gold"),
]), size=(40, 40), at=(300, 200), count=3, layer="things")

score = 0
font = pygame.font.Font(None, 36)

running = True
while running:
    for event in pygame.event.get():
        if event.type == pygame.QUIT:
            running = False
        elif event.type == pygame.KEYDOWN and event.key == pygame.K_ESCAPE:
            running = False
        # Open Nest: clicking monsters -- or Space with the player over it -- hits it: a point, and it goes round again.
        if event.type == pygame.MOUSEBUTTONDOWN or (event.type == pygame.KEYDOWN and event.key == pygame.K_SPACE):
            aim = event.pos if event.type == pygame.MOUSEBUTTONDOWN else player.center
            for monster in scene.get("monsters"):
                if monster.drawn_rect().collidepoint(aim):
                    score += 1
                    monster.respawn()
                    break

    keys = pygame.key.get_pressed()
    if keys[pygame.K_LEFT]:
        player.x -= PLAYER_SPEED
    if keys[pygame.K_RIGHT]:
        player.x += PLAYER_SPEED
    if keys[pygame.K_UP]:
        player.y -= PLAYER_SPEED
    if keys[pygame.K_DOWN]:
        player.y += PLAYER_SPEED

    player.clamp_ip(screen.get_rect())

    scene.update()
    # Open Nest: touching trees sends the player back to the start.
    if scene.touched(player, "trees"):
        player.topleft = (WIDTH // 2, HEIGHT // 2)
    screen.fill(BACKGROUND)
    scene.draw()
    pygame.draw.rect(screen, PLAYER_COLOUR, player)
    screen.blit(font.render(f"Score: {score}", True, SCORE_COLOUR), (10, 10))
    pygame.display.flip()
    clock.tick(60)

pygame.quit()
